## Terminal Retrospective Handoff

Before the closing response for `approved` or `escalated`, invoke the repo-owned `judgment-retrospective` skill. Pass only target, terminal state, round, aggregated counts, fixes and re-judgment result, intervention history, recurrence signal, and skill resolution. Append its compact status, summary, pattern updates, intervention history updates, recurrence/effectiveness note, and persisted observation IDs or topic keys after the primary verdict.
